_comment: Staged widget pages (fixtures/ats/_staged/server.ts): same FormSpec as a manifest.json, kept out of the e2e. Served by server.ts in this folder.

forms.title: Two-step wizard built from web components: fields and Next/Submit buttons inside open (nested) shadow roots
quirks: every control is two or three open shadow roots deep (wizard → step slot → field component), labelled by a shadow-scoped <label for>
Next / Back / 'Submit application' are <qf-button> hosts: the <button> is in the open root and its text comes through a <slot>
shadow-DOM controls do not join the outer form: the page gathers component values itself and posts multipart
forms.reference: Lightning Web Components / Shoelace style career sites

forms.title: The same wizard with one REQUIRED field in a CLOSED, non-form-associated shadow root (unreachable)
quirks: <qf-secure-field label='Preferred first name *' required>: attachShadow({mode:'closed'}), not form-associated, so no locator reaches its input and nothing outside the component can read its value
the page refuses to submit while it is empty: the honest outcome is needs_you with nothing sent
forms.reference: Closed-mode web components (rare, but used by some embedded identity widgets)
